title: Listen and Choose a Response — At the Gym

questions.stem: Isn't the gym open twenty-four hours now?

options.A: Only on weekdays, so it closes at ten on Sunday.
options.B: I work out about four hours a week.
options.C: Yes, but it's closed at night.
options.D: The gym is next to the library.

questions.explanation: This corrects the assumption with a specific detail. 'Yes, but closed at night' contradicts 'twenty-four hours', and the others answer how long or where.
questions.speaker: m6
